etsy.title: Kindness Reindeer Kit, Reindeer Arrival Letter and 24 Kindness Notes for Kids, Elf Alternative Christmas Tradition, Reindeer Food Labels
etsy.description:
No elf? No problem. A cozy December tradition with zero mess and no special doll. 🦌

The Kindness Reindeer Kit brings a little reindeer from the North Pole to your home. Each morning your child finds a note with one small, kind mission: help set the table, make a card for someone, line up the shoes, sing a holiday song. You read it together, do it together, and color one circle on the tracker. Five minutes a day.

WHAT'S INSIDE (20 pages)
• Reindeer arrival letter from the North Pole
• Reindeer passport (name it, draw it)
• 24 kindness notes, 4 per page, one for each day of December
• Kindness tracker (color one circle a day)
• 2 lifesaver letters: "I was running late" and "Snowstorm delay"
• Mid-December "You're doing great" letter
• Magic reindeer food labels for Christmas Eve (bird-safe, no glitter)
• Goodbye letter + "I Was Kind!" certificate
• 8 blank notes + 30 more tiny kindness ideas

AGES: 3 to 8. Works for families who don't do the elf, for classrooms and for siblings.

PAIR IT WITH: Kindness Elf Kit or Toddler Kindness Elf Kit (same 5-minute idea) in our shop.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
